description: Create a draft — saved as work-in-progress content that never publishes. The draft_planned_for field is a planning date only. Existing API keys need the new `drafts:write` scope added to gain draft access; no implicit grant occurs. Requires `platform` or a non-empty `platforms` array.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

draft_planned_for.description: ISO 8601 date/time for calendar placement (optional, does not schedule).

platform.description: Primary platform (e.g., "twitter", "instagram"). Provide `platform` or a non-empty `platforms` array — one of the two is required.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in. Do not ask the user for this UUID — call aidelly_list_workspaces and use the `id` of the matching workspace. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_create_draft
